items.name: NSE-Stock-Scanner
items.description: National Stock Exchange (NSE), India based Stock screener program. Supports Live Data, Swing / Momentum Trading, Intraday Trading, Connect to online brokers as Zerodha Kite, Risk Management, Emotion Control, Screening, Strategies, Backtesting, Automatic Stock Downloading after closing, live free day trading data and much more

items.name: Production-Grade-RSI-Momentum-Crypto-Trading-Strategy-with-Advanced-Statistical-Validation
items.description: Designed and implemented a quantitative trading backtesting framework for cryptocurrency perpetual futures (BNB/ETH/SOL-USDT) using Python, featuring Walk-Forward Optimization and Bootstrap Monte Carlo simulation for statistical validation.

items.name: flintstrats
items.description: Quantitative crypto trading strategies for perpetual futures -- beta-hedged stat-arb, momentum cascade, volatility breakout, and inflection detection built on the Flint backtesting engine

items.name: Binance-Future-Testnet
items.description: This script backtests a futures trading strategy using Binance data with multi-timeframe trend confirmation. Entries are triggered near short-term EMA compression, filtered by momentum and volume conditions. Results include detailed trade logs, win rates, and overall performance metrics across symbols and timeframes.

items.name: crypto-momentum-portfolio
items.description: Crypto Momentum Futures – Backtest & Parameter Search

items.name: momentum-backtest
items.description: MA(20/50) crossover momentum strategy backtested on 5yr WTI crude oil futures — walk-forward validation, 6-panel results dashboard, Sharpe 0.24, 13 trades

items.name: nifty_futures_backtesting
items.description: Quantitative backtesting project analyzing a moving average crossover strategy on NIFTY 50 Futures using Python. Includes volatility regime analysis, performance evaluation, and visual insights into market momentum and risk behavior.

items.name: gold-momentum-backtest
items.description: MA20/MA200 momentum backtest on Gold Futures (GC=F). 0 trades in 2.2 years — sustained bull trend means no crossovers triggered. Honest analysis of when trend-following signals fail. Python, yfinance, no paid data.

items.name: MVP-DaybreakMomentum
items.description: An MVP backtesting the Opening Range Breakout (ORB) intraday momentum strategy on VN30 index futures.

items.name: binance-futures-portfolio-engine
items.description: Browser-based quantitative portfolio backtesting engine for Binance Futures with momentum, risk-based strategies, and batch analysis.

items.name: Commodity-Price-Signal-Backtester
items.description: A quantitative backtesting framework to evaluate momentum and mean-reversion trading strategies on commodity futures (Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Corn).

items.name: oi-strategy-backtest
items.description: Intraday momentum strategy using Dhan API: real-time OI buildup + price + volume on NSE stock futures. Sharpe 2.93 net of brokerage and taxes.

items.name: commodity-futures-quant-risk-engine
items.description: Research-oriented commodity futures quant trading and risk engine. It builds daily-close backtests of three transparent strategies such as momentum, mean reversion, breakout that are evaluated honestly with realistic costs, out-of-sample testing, and full risk metrics (Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown, VaR/CVaR), plus a basic Streamlit dashboard.

items.name: tfx-trading
items.description: Monorepo for Taiwan TXF futures: trading-engine kernel, tick backtest, pluggable strategies (VWAP momentum), and Windows UAT app. Python 3.11+, Shioaji. Research / simulation — not investment advice.

items.name: us-treasury-multifactor-quant
items.description: A reproducible research framework for multifactor quantitative investing in U.S. Treasury bonds, covering yield-curve factors, Value, Momentum, Carry/Roll-down, Defensive signals, backtesting, risk management, and futures implementation.

items.name: GTAA-Long-Short-Factor-Based-Portfolio
items.description: GTAA factor portfolio system for 10 developed equity index futures. Implements momentum (12-1, risk-adjusted, 9-1) and volatility-of-volatility (36m) FMPs with 1% vol scaling, SLSQP combination optimization, and full OOS backtest (2016–2025). Training IR 0.45 → backtest IR 0.18.

items.name: binance-trades-imbalance-strategy
items.description: Trade Imbalance Monitoring strategy for Binance Futures.  A comprehensive script and backtest for tracking trade imbalances across Binance futures markets. While optimized for BTCUSDT perpetual contracts, the solution supports multiple trading pairs. The tool calculates real-time imbalance metrics to identify market momentum and liquidity pattern

items.name: 1h-4h-candle-Strategy
items.description: A comprehensive Streamlit-based backtesting dashboard for analyzing a four-candle Inside Bar momentum continuation strategy on Gold futures (GC=F).  This tool allows traders and researchers to systematically evaluate price action setups using real historical data, multi-dimensional filtering, and statistical validation.
